## Executive summary
Onboarding is slow and manual; a checklist lane fixes the ramp.

## Problem
Onboarding takes 6 hours (measured) of hand-holding per hire, roughly
$1,200/month (estimated) of senior time.

## Goals
- KPI-1 — onboarding time: 6 hours → under 2 hours.

## Scope
**In:**
- a self-serve onboarding checklist
**Out:**
- rewriting the HR tooling

## Definition of success
New hires productive within 2 hours, two quarters running.

## Stakeholders

## Risks
- Checklist goes stale. Accepted with an owner review each quarter.

## Constraints
- Zero new vendors.
